text:
incident-bot: PAGE: High error rate on inference-eu — fallback to 'chat-v2' for embeddings requests. 5xx surge + wrong response types. Trigger: regional fallback policy. svc=inference-router. alert: https://internal/alerts/3740012345

alice-oncall: paging @sam-sre @lina-ml — getting customer 500s and embed endpoints returning chat-like payloads :eyes:

sam-sre: looking now. quick grep shows alias 'release-2026-03' was remapped to chat-variant during the rollout, router honored pin -> incompatible interface

lina-ml: confirmed. alias points to chat-instruct variant; expected was embed-v3-quant. router fallback policy allowed interface-incompatible variant -> type mismatch on decode path

derek-eng: short-term mitigation idea: block chat variants for that alias via policy override: `policy.override(alias="release-2026-03", allow_interfaces=["embeddings"])`

sam-sre: applying override. running: `curl -s -X POST https://router.internal/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"alias":"release-2026-03","allowed_interfaces":["embeddings"]}'`

ops-bot: action recorded: override request submitted by sam-sre. rollback-window=10m

maria-cs: customer-impact summary: ~1.2k failed embed requests in EU over 10m, 2 customers reported search degradation, CS already messaged affected tenants

alice-oncall: if override doesn't stabilize in 5m, @ops-bot please rollback alias mapping to `embed-v3-quant` and notify customers of temporary remediation

ops-bot: rollback queued by alice-oncall. confirm to proceed? (yes/no)

sam-sre: override applied — router metrics: 5xxs dropping, embedding response shape restored. traces show old chat tokens no longer served. monitoring for 3m

lina-ml: post-action note: need alias validation in CI to ensure interface compatibility before pin/rollout. filing ticket INFR-1428 to add ABI check for model-interface in rollout pipeline

derek-eng: will add canary check + preflight in rollout script, PR target in 30m, will pair with lina for tests

maria-cs: customers notified. no active P1s. keeping incident open for 1h to watch for regressions

alice-oncall: good work — move to postmortem channel and assign INFR-1428 owner after stabilization :thumbsup:
